summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a shared React CSS repo config but ships an obfuscated `setup.mjs` wired to the npm `preinstall` lifecycle hook. On install, `setup.mjs` downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled ~720KB `math_init.js` file shipped inside the package. `math_init.js` is a Bun-target bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose contents are hidden behind a rotating string-array decoder, and `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with `_0x`-style identifiers and per-function string maps. A shared CSS/lint config has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or a bundled opaque executable payload; using an alternate runtime for the execution step also evades Node-based inspection of what runs at install time. The result is arbitrary, attacker-controlled code execution on any machine that runs `npm install` for this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
